## What the chronicles say [Record]

Nothing in the record.

## What really happened [Saga]

Žiežirba dies in early March 1450 and is cremated on the beach; the silver wolf passes to [Rimgailė](../characters/rimgaile_palanga.qmd); the kneeling statue glows once with remembering, and the sea takes her (Book V ch. 29). The frame closes: "Vanduo siekia smakrą."

## Consequences

Ends the [kneeling statue](../artifacts/kneeling_woman.qmd)'s watch on the shore.

## Dramatisation

Book V ch. 29 (frame); the 1553 epilogue is ch. 30.
